title: Naturality of stage sections comparison
statement: For any morphism f : X → S, geometric point s of S, arrow a : i → j of its small pointed affine étale neighbourhood category, and any integer cochain complex M of abelian sheaves on X, the explicitly constructed sourceStageSectionsIso intertwines the direct-image sections restriction along a with sectionsPullbackNat along the base-changed arrow followed by upperStarComp.inv on M, as an equality of chain maps. No injectivity or boundedness hypothesis is required. The named comparison constructions are those of [def-weil-pbc-strict-local-injective-source-comparison].

proof.text: Apply HomologicalComplex.Hom.ext and reduce to each degree k. Instantiate objectSections_naturality for the pullback of the neighbourhood arrow and the degree-k sheaf M.X k, then postcompose with the inverse of the upperStarComp component and cancel the hom/inverse pair under the sections functor.

Rewrite sectionsPullbackNat at the relevant sheaf by its explicit global-sections upper-star map, using naturality of terminal evaluation. The resulting pointwise equality is exactly the postcomposed object-sections naturality equation.

lean.statement:
theorem sourceStageSectionsIso_naturality {X S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    {Ω : Type v} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S)
    {i j : SmallModel.{v} (Scheme.strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods s)} (a : i ⟶ j)
    (M : CochainComplex (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}) ℤ) :
    (NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex
      ((sheafSections S.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}).map
        ((strictLocalNeighbourhoods s).map a).op) (.up ℤ)).app
          (((lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj M) ≫
      (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (sourceStageSectionsIso f s i) (.up ℤ)).hom.app M =
    (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (sourceStageSectionsIso f s j) (.up ℤ)).hom.app M ≫
      ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex
        (sectionsPullbackNat ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodDiagram f s).map a))
          (.up ℤ)).app
            (((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}
              ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodProjection f s).app j)).mapHomologicalComplex
                (.up ℤ)).obj M) ≫
        ((Sheaf.Γ ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodDiagram f s).obj i).smallEtaleTopology
          AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
            ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex
              (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}
                ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodDiagram f s).map a)
                ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodProjection f s).app j)
                ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodProjection f s).app i)
                ((Category.comp_id _).symm.trans
                  ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodProjection f s).naturality a).symm))
              (.up ℤ)).inv.app M))
